name: Super Mario Bros
summary: NES SMB emulator for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks (no ROM bundled). Downloads ROM from external source on first launch.
description: Super Mario Bros NES emulator for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks. Runs in a WebView using jsnes. Downloads the Super Mario Bros ROM from an external source on first launch so no copyrighted ROM is bundled (legally clean). TV remote mapping: D-Pad, Menu=Start, Back=Select, Fast-forward=A, Play/Pause=B. No WebView browsing, d-pad navigable.
author: FYAISA contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/smb with the Vega SDK.

notes: Super Mario Bros NES emulator (jsnes). Downloads the ROM from an external host on first launch (no ROM bundled).
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.
